function.name: person_detection
function.description: detect people in the camera view (STM32MP257F-DK, CPU) and return how many persons are seen

function.name: await_person
function.description: Alerts the user when a person appears. Send the user a message when a person is detected by the camera. Use this when the user says 'start monitoring for a person', 'wait for a person', or 'alert me when you see a person'.
